meta.name: Generate sales research briefs from Google Sheets with Claude and Slack

parameters.content:
## Autonomous Sales Research Agent

This workflow automatically researches prospects from a queue, pulling company insights, recent news, funding history, technology stack, and decision-maker contacts from multiple sources. It then uses AI to synthesize everything into a concise, personalized sales brief with an outreach recommendation and a draft first-touch message, so reps spend less time researching and more time selling.

### Who's it for
- SDR/BDR teams who need a fast, consistent research pass before outreach
- AEs prepping for a first call or demo
- RevOps teams standardizing account research across a team
- Anyone replacing manual LinkedIn/Google tab-hopping with one automated pass

### How it works
1. A schedule trigger polls a Prospects queue in Google Sheets for rows marked 'New'
2. Each prospect is researched in parallel across three source types: company website + recent news, funding + technology data, and decision-maker contacts
3. The three research branches are merged and scored for priority and research completeness
4. Prospects with at least one usable data source move forward; thin/empty profiles are skipped
5. AI (Claude) writes a structured sales brief: company overview, news summary, funding summary, tech angle, key decision makers, pain points, personalized icebreakers, recommended channel/timing, and a draft outreach message
6. The brief is logged to a SalesBriefs sheet, the prospect's status is updated to 'Researched', and the assigned rep is notified in Slack

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add Anthropic Claude credentials and attach to the Anthropic model node
3. Swap the three research HTTP Request nodes for your real data providers (e.g. SerpAPI/NewsAPI for news, Crunchbase/Clearbit for funding & tech, Apollo/People Data Labs for decision makers) and add their API keys
4. Switch the Google Sheets HTTP nodes to the native Google Sheets node with OAuth2, or add OAuth2 credentials directly
5. Replace YOUR_SHEET_ID in all Sheets HTTP nodes with your actual Spreadsheet ID
6. Replace YOUR_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL with your Slack Incoming Webhook URL
7. Set up your Google Sheet with three tabs: Prospects, SalesBriefs (column layouts below)
8. Set the schedule interval to match how often new prospects are added (default: every 15 minutes)
9. Activate the workflow

### Requirements
- Anthropic Claude API key (claude-sonnet-4 recommended)
- News/search API (e.g. SerpAPI, NewsAPI)
- Company enrichment API for funding & technology data (e.g. Crunchbase, Clearbit, BuiltWith)
- People/contact enrichment API for decision makers (e.g. Apollo, People Data Labs)
- Google Sheets with OAuth2 credentials (Prospects, SalesBriefs tabs)
- Slack Incoming Webhook (optional, for rep notifications)

### How to customize
- Adjust priority/completeness scoring weights in JS - Compile Research Profile & Priority Score
- Raise or lower the minimum data bar in Filter - Sufficient Data For Brief (default: completeness score >= 25)
- Add an email node alongside Slack for reps who prefer inbox notifications
- Add a CRM write-back step (HubSpot/Salesforce) instead of, or in addition to, Google Sheets
- Add a fourth research branch (e.g. G2/review site sentiment) by following the existing branch + merge pattern

### Google Sheets Column Layout

Prospects tab - row 1 headers:
Prospect ID | Company Name | Domain | Industry | Contact Name | Contact Title | Contact Email | Status

SalesBriefs tab - row 1 headers:
Generated At | Prospect ID | Company Name | Contact Name | Contact Title | Priority Score | Company Overview | Recent News Summary | Funding Summary | Tech Stack Summary | Key Decision Makers | Pain Points & Opportunities | Icebreakers | Recommended Channel | Recommended Timing | Outreach Message Draft

## Stage 1: Prospect Queue Intake

Schedule Trigger polls on a fixed interval (default every 15 minutes).

Fetch New Prospects pulls every row from the Prospects tab.

JS - Parse Prospect Rows keeps only rows with Status = 'New', maps columns into named fields, and records each row's sheet row number (for the later status update).

Split Out - Prospects turns that array into one item per prospect so the rest of the workflow researches each prospect independently.

## Stage 2: Multi-Source Research

Three branches run in parallel per prospect:

- Company Website & News Search: recent news mentions and public signals
- Funding & Technology Data: funding stage/amount, headcount, and detected technologies
- Decision Makers Lookup: names, titles, and contact details for relevant roles

Each HTTP call is followed by a small JS node that pulls the original prospect fields back in (via the Split Out - Prospects reference) and attaches the new signals, so nothing is lost.

Two chained Merge nodes (combine by position) reconverge the three branches into a single research object per prospect.

JS - Compile Research Profile & Priority Score scores each prospect 0-100 on both sales priority and research completeness, so thin profiles can be filtered out before spending an AI call on them.

## Stage 3: AI Sales Brief Generation

Filter - Sufficient Data For Brief lets through only prospects with a research completeness score of 25+ (at least one source returned usable data), so empty profiles never trigger an AI call.

A Wait buffer respects API rate limits, then the brief-writing AI (claude-sonnet-4, temperature 0.3 for grounded, consistent output) turns the merged research object into a structured brief: overview, news/funding/tech summaries, key decision makers, pain points, icebreakers, recommended channel/timing, and a draft outreach message.

JS - Parse Sales Brief Output extracts the structured JSON safely, with a fallback that builds a minimal generic brief from the raw research fields if AI parsing fails.

## Stage 4: Logging & Rep Notification

JS - Format Sales Brief Record assembles the row for the SalesBriefs tab.

Save Sales Brief to Google Sheets appends that row.

Update Prospect Status to Researched writes 'Researched' back into the prospect's Status cell using the row number captured in Stage 1, so it's never researched twice.

Send Slack Notification to Sales Rep posts a short summary and the outreach draft to a Slack channel or webhook so the rep sees it land.
